topic: Naming parameter for inventory working hours
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on naming a new boolean parameter that indicates whether to use specific working hours when referencing inventory data. [p1] initially asked how to name this parameter, and the participants agreed on 'InventoryWorkingHours' (iwh).
decisions: The parameter for checking inventory working hours will be named 'InventoryWorkingHours' (iwh) and will be a boolean type.
